review_improvement: Keeps the complete executable all-link scope, replaces unsafe truncated evidence with immutable per-lane validation, and makes live cardinality and fabric recovery explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: The `-all` set is determined by live topology, so the CSV cardinality must be derived from enumerated links and lanes rather than copied. A row can satisfy ErrCnt while still exposing zero usable margin, which is why all six nonzero fields are independent criteria. Because margining perturbs every XGMI link, concurrent GPU work or a blind rerun would confound results and increase fabric risk.
